# Highlight

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Highlight")`

Draws an outline and a tint over a part or a model, to mark what is selected, what can be picked up, or an ally behind a wall. It is drawn over the finished frame in the colors you set, unaffected by lighting. It is visual only: nothing collides with it, and raycasts do not hit it.

At most `[render] max_highlights` are drawn per frame (32 by default). Beyond that, the nearest are drawn.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Adornee` | `(BasePart | Model)?` | — | read/write | The part or model to highlight. A model highlights every part in it. With nil, the highlight's parent is highlighted. |
| `DepthMode` | `Enum.HighlightDepthMode` | `Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop` | read/write | Whether the highlight shows through objects in front of the shape, or only where the shape itself is visible. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the highlight is drawn. |
| `FillColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 0.2, 0.2)` | read/write | The color of the tint drawn over the whole shape. |
| `FillTransparency` | `number` | `0.5` | read/write | How transparent the fill is, from 0 (it hides what it covers) to 1 (only the outline shows). |
| `OutlineColor` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The color of the line around the edge of the shape. |
| `OutlineTransparency` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How transparent the outline is, from 0 (solid) to 1 (no outline). |
